finding: The last rank owns the remainder row, but fixed-count MPI_Scatter sends only floor(n/ranks) rows per rank from rank 0. With n=513 and 128 ranks, the last rank allocates five rows yet receives only four; its final row stays zero-initialized. Factorization therefore encounters a nonpositive final pivot. That owner returns before the final row broadcast, while peers remain in the collective, so the failure becomes a timeout. The later fixed-count gather also disagrees with the remainder ownership, but is not reached in this observation.
observed_failure: Stderr reports a non-positive-definite matrix at diagonal element 512 before the 30-second timeout. This is exactly the omitted remainder row. The paired repetition r2 passes in 11.796952 seconds, below the unchanged timeout.
interpretation: The missing scatter tail and unmatched failure-path collective are pre-existing program defects, not evidence of scheduling contention. Retain the failure without a retry and classify the added correctness case at the external-validation stage.
investigation: Static inspection, retained stderr, and the paired passing execution; no retry.
